import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,"engine")
from odata_client import ODataClient
c=ODataClient()
acc={a["Ref_Key"]:((a.get("Code") or "").strip(),(a.get("Description") or "").strip())
     for a in c.list("ChartOfAccounts_Хозрасчетный", select=["Ref_Key","Code","Description"])}
keys={k for k,(code,d) in acc.items() if code in {"1110","1210","1220","1300"}}
n=0
for r in c.list("AccountingRegister_Хозрасчетный_RecordType"):
    if r.get("AccountDr_Key") not in keys and r.get("AccountCr_Key") not in keys: continue
    arrays={k:v for k,v in r.items() if isinstance(v,(list,dict))}
    if not arrays: continue
    n+=1
    print("=== рух: Дт %s / Кт %s | сума %s"%(acc.get(r.get("AccountDr_Key"),("?",))[0],
          acc.get(r.get("AccountCr_Key"),("?",))[0], r.get("Сумма")))
    for k,v in arrays.items():
        print("   %s = %s"%(k, json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False)[:400]))
    if n>=2: break
if not n: print("масивів (субконто) у полях руху НЕМАЄ")
EOF
